name: spotify-bulk-playlist-builder
description: Full-stack web application to batch parse, search, match, and add 40-50+ tracks to Spotify playlists using official Web API and PKCE OAuth.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
